keywords: Film industry – Distribution/exhibition of local films – Rule limiting first exhibition to 35 copies – Ministerial approval – Acting Minister subsequently exempting films whose production had commenced before 1 January 2013 – Certiorari, Prohibition and Mandamus – Whether administrative correspondence constituted a rule validly made under statute – Petitioners’ legal premise rejected – No basis for writ relief – Application dismissed without costs.
